findings.reason: confirmationAfter builds the list it writes back from the rows alone. listExposedProjectRows skips the project's own exposed name (`own`) in all three loops, including the new confirmed-names loop in src/server/services/exposed-projects.ts around line 182. So a name this project exposes itself that is stored in confirmedSkillUses (the route test's 'shop-skill' case) has no row. PUT /uses-confirmation replaces the stored list whole, so the next Confirm or add-row save from the #skills card drops that confirmation without notice. The goal says the card sends back all confirmed names. Either include the own confirmed name in what the card can see, or merge server-side, or document this as a deliberate exclusion.
